paper: MountainLion: A Multi-Modal LLM-Based Agent System for Interpretable and Adaptive Financial Trading
headline_strategy: Four-agent crypto forecasting and recommendation system combining OHLCV windows, historical and real-time news, sentiment, GraphRAG/Perplexity retrieval, LLM and machine-learning forecast tracks, adaptive convex fusion, central reflection, and feedback-updated recommendations
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable and not directly a monthly U.S.-stock policy; public product components read precomputed crypto forecasts but do not generate the paper forecasts or positions
missing_headline_objects: forecast training panel, exchange, dates, candle frequency, preprocessing and split
ML estimator, fitted model, cross-validation folds/scores and prediction arrays
exact LLM snapshots, substituted prompts, requests/responses, tools, parameters and seeds
GraphRAG graph/data, retrieval provenance, sentiment embeddings and news recommendation records
adaptive-alpha optimizer, LLM/ML horizon alignment, reflection and feedback implementation
private ml4gp modules, plugin, MySQL/Redis schemas/state and service credentials
portfolio rule, actions, holdings, fills, cash, fees, returns and benchmark path

result_policy: No database-reader output, fresh prompt run, formula-only fusion, table/figure inference, or generic JKP mapping is entered as a MountainLion return. The paper reports forecast errors but no auditable trading return; its forecasting claims remain unresolved.
